outcome: Expression level of miRNA-145 in endometrial tissues
Expression level of IGF-1R in endometrial tissues
cohort: The study included 37 patients with hydrosalpinx infertility, 30 patients with endometriosis, and 28 normal women who underwent abortion operation from a hospital.
finding: Patients with hydrosalpinx infertility showed significantly higher miRNA-145 and lower IGF-1R expression in endometrial tissues compared to endometriosis and control groups, with these expression levels correlating significantly with the severity of hydrosalpinx.
